scope: standing desk setup plus O01 producer-reviewer cycle
observations: Staff sent no progress or completion mail merely to wake the lead.
The lead woke after the Runtime observed the producer terminal state.
The lead woke again after exact reviewer completion and safe promotion.
The callback used a durable Work-linked terminal fact, not a timeout, heartbeat or owner relay.
post_run_hardening: The live callback was then made crash-recoverable with an Attempt outbox bit. Completion and owed state commit together; message delivery and clearing commit together; daemon reconciliation flushes any owed fact exactly once.
